name: Tofu & Soba Noodle Stir Fry with Spinach & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Add salt and noodles and stir for a few seconds. Cook according to package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
510 g (1 quarter coin = 57 g) soba (buckwheat) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Drain and medium dice tofu; place on paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a large bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (340 g) pkgs extra firm tofu
3 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach, mushrooms, and green onions. Thinly slice the mushrooms. Trim root ends and chop onions. Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
0.681 kg white mushrooms
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and, stirring occasionally, cook until browned, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together soy sauce, sesame oil, and honey.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add mushrooms and cook until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Add spinach and gently stir until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Return tofu to skillet. Add soba noodles, green onions, and sauce. Stir to combine and cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place stir fry in a bowl. Enjoy!
